name: Sentora Huma PST Main
oneLiner: senPYUSDPST is Sentora's PYUSD vault lending against Huma PST on Morpho; shares redeem into available PYUSD and bear lending losses.
collateral: PYUSD held idle in an immutable Morpho Vault V2 and supplied by a MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 to a Huma PST-collateralized lending market. Allocations can change under curator controls.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares convert to PYUSD at the live assets-per-share rate. Interest, fees and recognized losses change share value. At Ethereum block 26197000 (2026-10-15T09:24:59Z), liquidityAdapter() was zero, so ordinary cash redemptions used idle PYUSD unless assets were first deallocated. Permissionless forceDeallocate carries a 1% penalty on the deallocated amount and remains subject to market liquidity. An in-kind position exit does not promise full-size cash redemption. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity.
